note: Difficulty for a context-dependence bench is how deeply the signal is buried. Every scored section keeps the SAME 20 probes at every tier — only the surrounding haystack grows. That isolates one axis: a higher tier is not a different question, it is the same question under more noise. D3 reproduces the historical default (CDB_S6_N=300), so pre-ladder runs sit at D3 rather than being stranded off the scale.

D2.note: Signal is findable by reading everything.

D3.note: Historical default. Context-stuffing still fits a large window.

D4.note: Stuffing starts to crowd out the answer.

D5.note: Beyond a comfortable window; retrieval should separate from stuffing here.

D6.note: Stuffing is not an option. Only resolution-quality retrieval survives.
